name: clawd-hud-zq
description: clawd-hud-zq: two Claude Code mods, each installed on its own: a HUD side pane with session facts, subagents and animated mascots (the session's mascot walks above the prompt on a tour of the world's wonders and tidies the conversation up when its context has grown; smooth vector mascots in the desktop app, Ghostty and kitty), and a strip above the prompt with thumbnails of the images pasted into it.

plugins.name: mod-hud
plugins.description: A side pane, toggled by /mod-hud: a HUD of the session (header, alerts, then session, context and prompt cache, limits, usage and todos in labelled sections) above every subagent in it (type, model, status, elapsed time, tool calls, current tool, result), with an opt-in status line; the session's own mascot walks the band above the prompt and tidies the conversation up (compacts it) when its context has grown; in the desktop app and in Ghostty or kitty the mascots are smooth vector art, on a tour of the world's wonders.

plugins.name: mod-images
plugins.description: Thumbnails of the images pasted into the prompt, in a strip just above it before you send: real pixels in kitty and Ghostty, coloured half-block cells in other terminals, and /mod-images to see what it sees.
